231.sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
    GROUP BY bond_type
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
molecule_info AS (
    SELECT label AS carcinogenic
    FROM molecule
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
)
SELECT bc.bond_type, mi.carcinogenic
FROM bond_counts bc
CROSS JOIN molecule_info mi;
